query.esql:
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS cpu = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_utilization`),
        mem = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_utilization`),
        eph_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`),
        eph_total = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/total_bytes`),
        pid_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/pid_used`),
        pid_limit = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/pid_limit`),
        status = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp)
    BY resource.attributes.node_name, attributes.condition
| STATS cpu = MAX(cpu), mem = MAX(mem), eph_used = MAX(eph_used), eph_total = MAX(eph_total), pid_used = MAX(pid_used), pid_limit = MAX(pid_limit),
        ready = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition == "Ready", status, NULL)),
        pressure = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition IN ("MemoryPressure", "DiskPressure", "PIDPressure") AND status == "True", attributes.condition, NULL)),
        problems = COUNT(CASE(attributes.condition != "Ready" AND attributes.condition NOT IN ("KubeletConfigChanged", "SysctlChanged") AND NOT STARTS_WITH(attributes.condition, "Deprecated") AND status == "True", 1, NULL))
    BY resource.attributes.node_name
| EVAL Saturation = GREATEST(cpu, mem),
       Ready = COALESCE(ready, "Unknown"),
       Pressure = COALESCE(pressure, "—"),
       `Problem conditions` = problems,
       `CPU %` = 100 * cpu,
       `Memory %` = 100 * mem,
       `Ephemeral storage %` = 100 * eph_used / eph_total,
       `PIDs %` = 100 * pid_used / pid_limit
| KEEP resource.attributes.node_name, Saturation, Ready, Pressure, `Problem conditions`, `CPU %`, `Memory %`, `Ephemeral storage %`, `PIDs %`
| SORT Saturation DESC
| LIMIT 100

FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS cpu = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/cpu/allocatable_utilization`),
        mem = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/memory/allocatable_utilization`),
        eph_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`),
        eph_total = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/ephemeral_storage/total_bytes`),
        pid_used = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/pid_used`),
        pid_limit = AVG(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/pid_limit`),
        status = LAST(attributes.status, @timestamp)
    BY resource.attributes.node_name, attributes.condition
| STATS cpu = MAX(cpu), mem = MAX(mem), eph_used = MAX(eph_used), eph_total = MAX(eph_total), pid_used = MAX(pid_used), pid_limit = MAX(pid_limit),
        ready = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition == "Ready", status, NULL)),
        pressure = MAX(CASE(attributes.condition IN ("MemoryPressure", "DiskPressure", "PIDPressure") AND status == "True", attributes.condition, NULL)),
        problems = COUNT(CASE(attributes.condition != "Ready" AND attributes.condition NOT IN ("KubeletConfigChanged", "SysctlChanged") AND NOT STARTS_WITH(attributes.condition, "Deprecated") AND status == "True", 1, NULL))
    BY resource.attributes.node_name
| EVAL Saturation = GREATEST(cpu, mem),
       Ready = COALESCE(ready, "Unknown"),
       Pressure = COALESCE(pressure, "—"),
       `Problem conditions` = problems,
       `CPU %` = 100 * cpu,
       `Memory %` = 100 * mem,
       `Ephemeral storage %` = 100 * eph_used / eph_total,
       `PIDs %` = 100 * pid_used / pid_limit
| KEEP resource.attributes.node_name, Saturation, Ready, Pressure, `Problem conditions`, `CPU %`, `Memory %`, `Ephemeral storage %`, `PIDs %`
| SORT Saturation DESC
| LIMIT 100

embeddableConfig.description: Nodes of this cluster, worst first by saturation: the higher of average CPU and memory allocatable utilization. Ready, Pressure and Problem conditions use each condition's latest status (`node/status_condition`); Pressure lists an active MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure. Click a node to open its detail.
embeddableConfig.title: List of nodes

query.esql:
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
    AND (attributes.deployment IS NOT NULL OR attributes.statefulset IS NOT NULL OR attributes.daemonset IS NOT NULL)
| EVAL kind = CASE(attributes.deployment IS NOT NULL, "Deployment", attributes.statefulset IS NOT NULL, "StatefulSet", "DaemonSet"),
       name = COALESCE(attributes.deployment, attributes.statefulset, attributes.daemonset)
| STATS desired = MAX(CASE(kind == "Deployment", `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_spec_replicas/gauge`,
                           kind == "StatefulSet", `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_replicas/gauge`,
                           `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled/gauge`)),
        ready_avail = MAX(CASE(kind == "Deployment", `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/gauge`,
                           kind == "StatefulSet", `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready/gauge`,
                           `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_ready/gauge`)),
        updated = MAX(CASE(kind == "Deployment", `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_status_replicas_updated/gauge`,
                           kind == "StatefulSet", `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_status_replicas_updated/gauge`,
                           `metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_updated_number_scheduled/gauge`)),
        misscheduled = MAX(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_misscheduled/gauge`)
    BY kind, name, resource.attributes.namespace
| EVAL shortfall = desired - ready_avail
| WHERE shortfall > 0 OR misscheduled > 0
| RENAME resource.attributes.namespace AS Namespace, name AS Name, kind AS Kind, shortfall AS Shortfall, desired AS Desired, ready_avail AS `Ready or available`, updated AS Updated, misscheduled AS Misscheduled
| KEEP Kind, Namespace, Name, Shortfall, Desired, `Ready or available`, Updated, Misscheduled
| SORT Shortfall DESC
| LIMIT 100

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
| STATS received = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/received_bytes_count`)),
        sent = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/sent_bytes_count`))
    BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket ASC

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default

        sent = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/sent_bytes_count`))
    BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Bytes per second received and sent by all nodes in the cluster, summed (`node/network/received_bytes_count` and `node/network/sent_bytes_count` rates).
embeddableConfig.title: Network traffic per second

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
| STATS traffic = AVG(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/received_bytes_count`)) + AVG(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/sent_bytes_count`))
    BY node = resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket ASC, traffic DESC, node ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY bucket

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
| STATS traffic = AVG(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/received_bytes_count`)) + AVG(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/network/sent_bytes_count`))
    BY node = resource.attributes.node_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket ASC, traffic DESC, node ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY bucket

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS bytes = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/logs/input_bytes`))
    BY attributes.type, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT bucket ASC
